description.value: A 24-hour 7-Eleven convenience store co-located at an Esso fuel station on 2nd Avenue West in Prince Rupert. Prince Rupert sits at the western end of the Yellowhead Highway and is a major BC Ferries hub for Haida Gwaii and Alaska sailings, making this round-the-clock stop particularly valuable for cyclists catching early or late ferries. The station also has an ATM on-site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an ESSO 7-Eleven 32167 at 250 2ND AVE W, Prince Rupert, with phone 250-627-8348 matching OSM exactly. The station page lists 'Convenience store' as a feedback category (confirming retail stock) and 'Washroom' as a separate feedback category (confirming washrooms exist). The page states 'Open 24 hours' and shows an ATM. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: The OSM website URL points to esso.ca rather than 7-eleven.com; the listing is branded 'ESSO 7-Eleven 32167' on the Esso site, indicating this is a dual-branded Esso/7-Eleven location. OSM name '7-Eleven' is accurate but incomplete.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open 24-hour convenience store and fuel station confirmed by the Esso website, with matching address and phone. Valuable resupply and ATM stop for cyclists in Prince Rupert.

wow_evidence: Open 24 hours… major BC Ferries hub for Haida Gwaii and Alaska sailings… ATM on-site
